## 1.0.0 (2026-11-16)

### ✨ New Features

* DeepSeek patches (PairIP bypass, package rename, microG-RE support) ([666405c](https://github.com/bicybert/deepseek-patches/commit/666405c8e6ff9d17603e6ca6364d27167538d3bc))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* restore README patch-list markers for the release script ([d936664](https://github.com/bicybert/deepseek-patches/commit/d9366646d1a53f13498dd44ff24d69a9462bab13))

patches.name: Add microG-RE support
patches.description: Builds microG DeepSeek, a separate app that signs in to your Google account through microG-RE (MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore). Not for root installs.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs alongside stock DeepSeek under its own package name. On by default: a re-signed copy cannot replace the stock app.

options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name. Left at org.ungoogled.deepseek, Add microG-RE support installs under org.ungoogled.deepseek.microg instead.

patches.name: Remove PairIP license checks
patches.description: Neuters PairIP's license check, which contacts Google Play on every start and shuts the app down when it was not installed by Play. Needed for a re-signed copy to run at all.
